    Twice a first-order lift #

    integral-deformations.tex (proof of Lemma 10.2): "take module and map corrections for a first-order 𝔽₂-cocycle and use twice their lifts over 𝒪. Every equation is linear in ε; multiplication by two makes it depend only on the modulo-two base matrices."

    For a cocycle μ̃ = 2μ̄ over 𝒪, a lifted action ν of M for μ̄ gives the lifted action 2ν of a lift M̃ (actLiftTw), and a lifted map (f, g) gives (f̃, 2g) (isLiftHom_tw).
